item.description: It's claimed the country's roads are at their worst condition in decades. Sinn Fein TD for Cavan/Monaghan Matt Carthy says it's subjecting motorists to huge bills in repair costs. He says it's incredibly frustrating for people who are forced to rely on their cars. item.title: Local Farmer Warns of Dangers of Dogs Worrying Sheep
item.description: A local farmer has reminded people of the dangers and negative repercussions of dogs worrying sheep. According to Niamh Monahan from Inniskeen in Co Monaghan, dog owners are responsible for the whereabouts of their dog both night and day. If your dog is observed worrying sheep a farmer can take action in order to keep their sheep safe. item.title: Funding Confirmed to Explore Active Travel Scheme in Ballybay
item.description: The National Transport Authority have confirmed funding has been made available to explore the feasibility for the development of an active travel scheme linking Ballybay Main Street and the Town Park and schools. The funding will allow for vegetation removal and surveying of the proposed route and this work has commenced. item.title: Herbal cannabis worth €10.12m seized in Louth
item.description: On Friday the 30th of January 2026, as a result of ongoing investigations targeting organised crime activity under Operation TARA, a joint operation was conducted by the Garda National Drugs & Organised Crime Bureau and the Revenue Customs Service. This operation involved the search of a premises in the Co. Louth area and resulted in the seizure of 506kgs of Cannabis, with an estimated value of €10,120,000. item.title: Cavan Undertaker Says Traditional Irish Funerals Still Preferred
item.description: A Co Cavan undertaker says a traditional Irish funeral is still the primary choice for people living in the Northern Sound region. Colm Kieran of Kieran Brothers Funeral Directors says while traditional Irish funerals still make up for around 85 percent of his business, there is a clear increase in the number of cremations. item.title: Monaghan score Lanchasire hurling victory
item.description: Monaghan scored their first win of the hurling league campaign with a four point win over Lancashire. Monaghan scoring a 1-23 to 2-16 win in Abbotstown. In their first outing of the league, the Exiles led 11 points to nine at half-time. Lancashire led by four points in the second-half before Rowan McMahon got in for a timely goal for the Farney men.
